title: Create CI test workflow in .github/workflows/test.yml
description:
Create .github/workflows/test.yml GitHub Actions workflow for pull requests and pushes to main/master matching natelong/harper-odin parity (omitting x86 OSX):
- Multi-platform test matrix: macos-latest (Apple Silicon arm64), ubuntu-latest (Linux x86_64), and windows-latest (Windows x64).
- Setup Odin compiler using laytan/setup-odin@v2 with token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}.
- Verify Odin installation via odin version.
- Build libllama_odin shared and static libraries via CMake (with embedded Metal on macOS, and standard CPU targets on Linux and Windows).
- Run C-ABI sanity test suite (tests/c/test_abi.c).
- Run Odin test suite: odin test tests/odin/ -define:ODIN_TEST_THREADS=1.

Acceptance Criteria:
- .github/workflows/test.yml configured with multi-platform matrix (macos-latest, ubuntu-latest, windows-latest)
- Triggers on push and pull_request to main and master
- Sets up Odin compiler via laytan/setup-odin@v2
- Builds native libraries and executes both C-ABI and Odin test suites successfully across all matrix platforms
